question: Is spec-decode's near-tie losslessness failure fundamental, or an implementation bug? The answer decides whether Continuum step 6 is a re-scope or a re-measure.
verdict: IMPLEMENTATION BUG, AND ALREADY FIXED. The campaign ledger is stale.

verified_directly.title: fix(speculate): make spec-decode bit-identical to greedy + Event Horizon build-wave
verified_directly.root_cause: forward_tokens_verify returned the INPUT token for a single-token batch (B==1) instead of the model's argmax, and mis-wrote KV[pos]. Any 1-token draft at a repeat boundary therefore emitted a non-greedy token and corrupted the next step, making both the Event Horizon path and the legacy user-draft path silently non-lossless at near-ties. The old single-prompt parity test could not see it.
verified_directly.diagnosis_quality: A b-size matrix established that B=1 was ALWAYS wrong (top-2 margin 3.5-5.6) while B>=2 was exactly greedy -- so the defect was localized rather than attributed to batching in general.
verified_directly.fix: Route B==1 through the canonical greedy kernel inside the shared forward_tokens_verify; B>=2 keeps the batched GEMM, so the speedup is retained.
verified_directly.validation_claimed: event_horizon_parity_prop gates EH-ON and legacy-OFF against NO-SPEC canonical greedy, 20/20 bit-identical; new bsize_verify_diag asserts B=1..8 == greedy; 182/182 lib tests pass.

why_this_matters: 6,312 lines across 18 modules were being treated as blocked by a foundational impossibility -- 'batched verify cannot match sequential greedy at ties'. That framing was wrong. Batched verify at B>=2 was always exactly greedy. The zone is a RE-MEASURE, not a re-scope.

what_is_still_open.ledger_stale: The campaign ledger still records the gate as OPEN. It must be re-receipted, not rebuilt.
what_is_still_open.not_remeasured: The fix has not been re-receipted on the artifact that will actually be served.
what_is_still_open.tq_p0_blocked: The TQ path's P0 gate is separately blocked.

sealed_negatives_binding_do_not_rerun: EAGLE-3 head: NO-GO at tau=0.877, measured 0.40x/0.30x/0.21x tps
Free proposers as default: often net-negative despite accept rate
HIGH ACCEPT IMPLIES SPEEDUP: FALSIFIED -- 87 percent acceptance measured 0.91x, a slowdown. This is the single most important negative in the set: acceptance rate is not the objective.
n-gram floor: tau approx 1.43, below the 1.6 bar
DeepSeek batched ExactShared verify: reverted at -17/-20 tps
what_the_tournament_must_measure: Correctness FIRST -- exact tokens against the same-target greedy path -- then accepted tokens/second with FULL cost charging, gated on a lower confidence bound of 1.10 per workload class. Not acceptance rate, which is falsified as a proxy. Not 'retrain EAGLE', which is a sealed NO-GO.
shortest_path_to_unblocking_the_zone: Re-receipt P0 on the artifact that will be served
Inject measured costs and timings into the Event Horizon loop, killing the 1 ms placeholder
Register retrieval and the suffix automaton the way suffix_array already is
Keep neural and tree proposers refuse-closed until tau plus a 1.10 LCB oracle

Rename off the Eagle5 experiment name only after the above -- SpeculateMode::Eagle5, Eagle5Head, ProposerId::Eagle5 and the eagle5*.rs modules embed an experiment name in what should be a provider-neutral ABI
not_evidence_of: that the fix still holds on the current artifact -- that is exactly the re-measurement that is owed
